headline: Irisalis team
title: Best Irisalis Team | Leafy Somniwing Turbo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: The best team for Irisalis is Irisalis, Leafy, Somniwing and Turbo. Cast Leafy first, then Somniwing, then Turbo last so her damage buff is still running when you switch to Irisalis. Leafy and Somniwing keep her energy flowing, and Turbo adds damage. Learning a boss? Swap Turbo for Glacy to get more sustain. Which fourth slot do you prefer? Comment below!
description: Best Irisalis team in Aniimo (checked Nov 2026): Irisalis, Leafy, Somniwing, Turbo. Cast order Leafy, Somniwing, Turbo, then switch to Irisalis. Swap Turbo for Glacy for more sustain.
